# EasyTrader MCP

An open-source Model Context Protocol (MCP) server connecting AI agents (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Antigravity, ChatGPT) to the Tehran Stock Exchange (TSE) through Mofid Securities (`d.easytrader.ir`).

## Overview
EasyTrader MCP bridges LLMs with internal EasyTrader REST APIs over stdio using the official `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk`. It provides 25 structured tools covering market screening, orderbook depth, order placement and cancellation, portfolio tracking, mutual funds, derivatives, and account management.

## Capabilities
- **Portfolio & Accounting:** Purchasing power (T0/T1/T2), Hami fund interest balance, portfolio performance, breakeven calculations, and ledger history.
- **Market Screener & Ticker Forensics:** 5-level orderbook queues, institutional vs. individual order volume (حقیقی و حقوقی), Codal reports, sector heatmaps, and EasyFilter indicators.
- **Trading & Execution:** Direct buy/sell order dispatch with validity settings, active queue modifications, order revocations, and offline pre-order staging.
- **Financial Products & Facilities:** Option contract positions (اختیار معامله) and settlements, Mofid investment fund issuance (صدور) and redemption (ابطال), PointX club rewards, credit facility queries, and MofidCard balance inspection.
- **Market Alerts:** TSE supervisor messages (پیام ناظر بازار), halts, and reopenings.

## Tool List
1. `easytrader_auth_status`: Validate active session token and user profile brief.
2. `easytrader_update_session`: Update Bearer JWT token in runtime without server restart.
3. `easytrader_get_account_balance`: T0/T1/T2 purchasing power, Hami balance, and linked bank accounts.
4. `easytrader_get_transactions`: Detailed accounting transactions and cash flow history.
5. `easytrader_get_portfolio`: Portfolio holdings, share counts, breakeven prices, and daily activities.
6. `easytrader_get_funds`: Mutual fund asset breakdown and list of available Mofid funds.
7. `easytrader_get_market_overview`: TSE index changes, daily turnover, and market statistics.
8. `easytrader_get_market_map`: Sector heatmaps and real-time ticker percentage variations.
9. `easytrader_get_easyfilter_data`: Technical indicators and screens across 2,200+ TSE symbols.
10. `easytrader_get_symbol_details`: Best 5 bid/ask queues, closing/last prices, limits, and P/E.
11. `easytrader_get_symbol_analysis`: Smart money movements (حقیقی/حقوقی), technicals, and Codal filings.
12. `easytrader_get_orders`: Active market orders and historical execution reports.
13. `easytrader_send_order`: Submit new buy/sell orders with quantity and price parameters.
14. `easytrader_update_order`: Modify price or volume of queued orders.
15. `easytrader_cancel_order`: Cancel an open order by ID.
16. `easytrader_get_drafts`: View offline draft pre-orders.
17. `easytrader_create_draft`: Stage orders safely as offline drafts.
18. `easytrader_get_notifications`: Real-time supervisor alerts and NSC announcements.
19. `easytrader_get_credit_info`: PointX balance, available credit packages, and active requests.
20. `easytrader_apply_credit`: Submit credit facility applications using club points.
21. `easytrader_get_mofidcard`: MofidCard balance, linked Sheba, and card status.
22. `easytrader_get_options`: Derivative/option contract holdings and settlement status.
23. `easytrader_manage_fund_units`: Mutual fund unit issuance, redemption, and transaction records.
24. `easytrader_get_batch_quotes`: High-throughput quotes for multiple tickers in one request.
25. `easytrader_client_settings`: EasyTrader trading configurations and preferences.

## Authentication & Security
- Local-first execution over stdio without cloud intermediaries.
- Uses temporary session Bearer JWT tokens extracted from browser DevTools.
- Passwords and 2FA secrets are never handled or stored.
